Class Bundle

java.lang.Object
com.ospx.flubundle.Bundle
public class Bundle extends Object
A catalog of Fluent messages for several locales, with locale fallback and formatting.

Delivering messages to players lives in Messenger.

      public void setFormatErrorHandler(Consumer<fluent.bundle.FluentBundle.ErrorContext> formatErrorHandler)
      Sets the handler for errors that occur while rendering a message, such as a missing $variable or a failing function. By default each error is logged once.

      public Set<String> variables(String id)
